# ACE Fitness

> > The American Council on Exercise (ACE) is an NCCA-accredited certifying organization providing fitness certifications, continuing education, and resources for health and exercise professionals.

ACE offers four primary NCCA-accredited certifications (Personal Trainer, Group Fitness Instructor, Health Coach, and Medical Exercise Specialist) along with specialist programs, continuing education courses, and advocacy initiatives. The organization has been advancing the fitness profession for over 40 years through certification, education, and community engagement.

## Key Topics

- NCCA Accreditation
- ACE Personal Trainer Certification
- ACE Group Fitness Instructor Certification
- ACE Health Coach Certification
- Continuing Education Credits (CECs)
- Behavior Change Methodology
- Lifestyle Medicine
- Medical Exercise Specialist
- ACE Specialist Programs
- Motivational Interviewing
- ACE 7 Core Drivers of Healthy Living
- Fitness Nutrition Specialist
- Exercise Professional Advocacy
- CEC Power Pass
- ACE Mover Method

## Getting Started & Core Resources

- [ACE Fitness Homepage](https://acefitness.org): Homepage for ACE fitness certifications and education programs
- [Get Certified](https://acefitness.org/get-certified): Main certification programs page featuring PT, GFI, HC, and MES paths
- [My ACE Account Portal](https://learn.acefitness.org): Account portal login for ACE certified professionals and students
- [About ACE](https://acefitness.org/about-ace): ACE mission, NCCA accreditation, and organizational overview
- [Exercise Library](https://acefitness.org/resources/everyone/exercise-library): Searchable exercise database with bodyweight, gym, and home workouts

## Certification Programs

- [All ACE Certifications](https://acefitness.org/fitness-certifications/default.aspx): Overview of NCCA-accredited ACE certification programs
- [Personal Trainer Certification](https://acefitness.org/fitness-certifications/personal-trainer-certification/default.aspx): ACE Personal Trainer certification program and career information
- [Group Fitness Instructor Certification](https://acefitness.org/fitness-certifications/group-fitness-certification/default.aspx): ACE Group Fitness Instructor certification program details
- [Health Coach Certification](https://acefitness.org/fitness-certifications/health-coach-certification/default.aspx): ACE Health Coach certification using motivational interviewing methods

## Continuing Education

- [Continuing Education Overview](https://acefitness.org/continuing-education): Continuing education programs, specialist courses, and CEC options
- [ACE-Approved Courses](https://acefitness.org/continuing-education/ace-approved-courses): Directory of ACE-approved CEC courses from trusted providers

## Career & Professional Development

- [ACE Fitness Job Board](https://careers.acefitness.org): Job board for certified fitness professionals seeking employment
- [ACE Answers](https://acefitness.org/fitness-certifications/ace-answers): Self-service study support and certification exam preparation resources

## ACE Mission & Advocacy

- [Our Efforts](https://acefitness.org/about-ace/our-efforts): ACE mission, Mover Method, and organizational initiatives overview
- [Advocacy](https://acefitness.org/about-ace/our-efforts/advocacy): ACE advocacy efforts for exercise professionals and health policy
- [Community Engagement](https://acefitness.org/about-ace/our-efforts/engagement): ACE community programs promoting physical activity and health equity
